data.name: OpenAI Hits $10 Billion Revenue Quarter Amid Heavy Losses
data.summary: In Q3 2026, OpenAI's revenue surged nearly 50 percent from the prior quarter and more than doubled year-over-year, pushing its annual run rate toward $50 billion, with enterprise sales now half of total revenue and doubling in the period. data.name: Nod: Open-Source AI Agent Tackles Daily Admin Tasks Locally
data.summary: n8n Labs released Nod, a research preview of an open-source personal AI agent that automates everyday chores like requesting refunds, pulling statements from websites, and prepping morning briefs across apps such as Gmail, Slack, and Notion. It prioritizes user control by requiring explicit owner approval for actions like sending emails or payments, storing credentials locally, and providing detailed receipts—achieving 98% task completion in early tests with strong privacy safeguards.
